The '''Numol'elrul''', who referred to themselves as '''Numol''', were one of the six [[Species/Legends|subspecies]] of [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]]. The Nikto [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]] was subjected to [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] from a nearby [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]], which caused the Nikto to undergo accelerated evolutionary changes, resulting in the various subspecies. They had [[Color/Legends|deep-green]] skin with blue-green scales, and were adapted to aquatic life. They were [[Water/Legends|water]] breathers, but could breathe [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] for short periods of [[Time/Legends|time]]. Thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="LoNH" /> no later than [[4998 BBY]],<ref name="Date">According to ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'' the aftermath of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] forcing the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] off of [[Lirra]] is a current event. Since ''Lords of Nal Hutta establishes Empire's actions on Lirra to have taken place in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], and the Numol'elrul's isolation to have occurred five thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] ago, then it must have happened no later than [[4998 BBY]].</ref> the Numol'elrul retreated underwater, deciding to avoid the Nikto's politics and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts']] influence. They isolated themselves from the other Nikto subspecies and ceased all communication with them. The Numol'elrul Nikto lived in a sprawling complex located multiple [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] below the [[Glussa Island]], carved into the island's [[Stone/Legends|bedrock]]. Their isolation caused the other Nikto to believe them to be a legend, and as such it was believed that there were only five subspecies.<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Numol'elrul were mentioned in the [[2015]] sourcebook ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'', a supplement for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[roleplaying game]] series.<ref name="LoNH" />
